label: dragIsOneStep: the drag token not passed to setPath, so 120 handle moves are 120 undo steps
find: try t.setPath(path, name: title, drag: drag)
replace: try t.setPath(path, name: title, drag: nil)

label: closeNeedsThree: close allowed with two anchors
oneStepPerRun: setPath called per anchor in anchor-move, so moving three points records three steps
insertUnavailableOffThePath: the reach check dropped, so a click off the path adds a point
everyWhyNot: a handle drag on a point with no handle there runs without breaking
find: guard breaking || (p.end == .handleIn ? a.handleIn : a.handleOut) != nil else
replace: guard breaking || a.handleIn == nil || a.handleIn != nil else

label: drawRefusesFewerThanTwo: path.draw takes a single point
moveIsADocumentDeltaOnATransformedLayer: a move maps its delta through the layer's translation too
handleIsADocumentPointOnATransformedLayer: a handle drag lands its document point in path space unmapped
find: to: try local(e, "path.handle-move").apply(Point(x: p.x, y: p.y))

label: readIsDocumentSpaceOnATransformedLayer: path.read writes the path's own space
aLayerScaledToNothingRefusesPointEdits: a singular layer edits in document space instead of refusing
find: guard let back = try? e.toDocument.inverted() else { throw refused(id, flatHelp) }
